answer.submission_route: Molina is run per state. Sign in at molinahealthcare.com or call the number on your card, and mail your appeal to the address on your denial letter. Online: molinahealthcare.com member portal By phone: The Member Services number on your ID card Deadline: Confirm the window on your denial letter -- but your denial letter is authoritative. Use the appeal address printed on your denial letter.
answer.how_to_obtain_criteria: This plan does not publish criteria for this procedure. Ask the plan in writing for the exact criteria used in your denial.
answer.notes: no public criteria on file; abstained and routed
